name: Okta — Internal Network Login (Baseline, Disabled)
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType = "user.session.start"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS"
| filter ip contains "192.168." or ip contains "10." or ip contains "172.16." or ip contains "172.17." or ip contains "172.18." or ip contains "172.19." or ip contains "172.2" or ip contains "172.31."
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as logins, values(ip) as ip_list by user_name, _time
| fields user_name, ip_list
description: Okta user.session.start SUCCESS from RFC1918 source IP — every internal employee login. DISABLED by default; informational only for case timeline.
alert_description:
What fired: Okta user.session.start SUCCESS from RFC1918 source IP — every internal employee login. DISABLED by default; informational only for case timeline.

Why it matters: an actor may be gaining an initial foothold (phishing, exploit, or valid accounts). Assessed severity: Informational.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts (TA0001 - Initial Access).

Investigate:
  - Identify the entry vector, the targeted user/asset, and the source.
  - Check for successful access and any follow-on execution or persistence from the same actor.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (user_name) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
